map.TWSTRS 用于评估颈部肌张力障碍的运动异常、功能影响与疼痛。严重程度 10: TWSTRS assesses motor abnormality, functional impact and pain in cervical dystonia. Severity has 10 items (0–35), disability 6 items (0–30), pain 3 items (0–20), total 0–85; the duration item is entered on a 0–5 scale and doubled.
